description: Merchant Console Transactions vertical slice, end-to-end against real data. Implement a merchant-scoped read-model projection that assembles the front-end Transaction shape from runtime.workflow_intents (spine) + runtime.lifecycle_steps (transitions/state) + runtime.spend_ledger (amount), expose it via two new control-plane endpoints that satisfy the ALREADY-DEFINED api-client signatures, enforce tenant isolation, and replace the hardcoded DEMO_TRANSACTIONS array in the merchant console with a real useApi fetch (loading/empty/error states). Prove it against the live Supabase with a creds/DB-gated integration test that seeds and cleans up its own rows. Read context.json (read_model_mapping, key_patterns, environment_constraints) before starting. NOTE the SANDBOX FILE BUG: make ALL edits via bash heredoc and verify with git diff/cat before building.
steps: BACKEND read-model + store port: create apps/control-plane-api/src/transaction-routes.ts mirroring policy-routes.ts structure. Define API-layer types matching the front-end contract in apps/merchant-console/src/lib/types.ts EXACTLY (TransactionState union; TransactionStateTransition {from,to,timestamp,actor,evidenceRef}; Transaction {transactionId,merchantId,amount,currency:'INR',currentState,buyerRef,method,createdAt,transitions}). Define a TransactionReadStore PORT: list(merchantId, {limit,offset}, environment) => Promise<readonly Transaction[]>; get(transactionId, environment) => Promise<Transaction | undefined> (the raw store returns the row WITH its owning merchantId so the route can enforce scope). Provide createInMemoryTransactionStore() for local/test/development that holds seeded Transaction rows keyed by merchantId and by transactionId.

BACKEND state derivation: implement an explicit, documented pure function deriveTransactionState(intentStatus, orderedSteps) -> TransactionState and buildTransitions(orderedSteps, intentCreatedAt) -> TransactionStateTransition[]. Ground it in real semantics from apps/worker/src/real-lifecycle.ts: steps are shopify.draft / shopify.finalize / shopify.markPaid (+ .claim variants) with status completed|declined; a first 'initiated' transition anchors at intent.created_at; a completed draft => authorized, completed finalize => captured, completed markPaid => settled; any 'declined' step OR intent.status='failed' => failed. actor derived from the step's provider ('shopify' for shopify.* steps, 'system'/'buyer' for the synthetic initiated anchor); evidenceRef <- lifecycle_steps.reference. Keep the .claim rows OUT of the user-visible transitions. Document each mapping decision in a top-of-file comment.

BACKEND gaps: for buyerRef and method there is NO persisted source column today (lifecycle_steps.snapshot is currently always null; no buyer/method columns exist). Attempt to read them from workflow_intents.authority_context jsonb if present; otherwise emit an explicit documented placeholder (e.g. buyerRef: '' or 'unavailable', method: 'unknown') and record this as a KNOWN GAP in the feature findings. Do NOT fabricate plausible-looking buyer ids or payment methods.

BACKEND Postgres store: create apps/control-plane-api/src/transaction-store-postgres.ts exporting createPostgresTransactionStore(database: TransactionalDatabase): TransactionReadStore using raw database.query<Row>(sql, params). list: SELECT from runtime.workflow_intents WHERE environment=$env AND scope_kind='merchant' AND scope_id=$merchantId ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT/OFFSET; for each intent join runtime.lifecycle_steps ON idempotency_key = transaction_id (ordered by created_at) and runtime.spend_ledger ON reference = transaction_id for amount_minor/currency. get: resolve the single intent by transaction_id (+environment), returning its scope_id as the owning merchantId plus the assembled Transaction so the route can enforce tenant scope. Convert amount_minor MINOR->MAJOR (divide by 100). Consider environment: PostgresStepLedger hardcodes 'local'; make the store environment-parameterized and default sensibly (see how main.ts derives environment) so seeded rows in the integration test are found.

BACKEND routes/plugin: in transaction-routes.ts export transactionRoutesPlugin(fastify, { store, environment }). Register permissions: registerRoutePermission('GET:/control/v1/merchants/:merchantId/transactions', { permission: 'identity.scope.read' }) and registerRoutePermission('GET:/control/v1/transactions/:transactionId', { permission: 'identity.scope.read' }). Implement GET /control/v1/merchants/:merchantId/transactions: verifyTenantAccess(request, merchantId) (copy the exact helper semantics from policy-routes.ts using getActorContext), parse limit/offset query (defaults limit=50, offset=0, clamp/validate), return store.list(...) as a JSON array (the api-client expects readonly Transaction[] directly as the body). Implement GET /control/v1/transactions/:transactionId: fetch via store.get; if undefined => 404; then enforce tenant scope by checking the row's owning merchantId against the caller's scope (platform allowed; merchant must match) => 403/404 for mismatch so a merchant CANNOT read another merchant's transaction by id; return the Transaction object as the body.

BACKEND wiring: in apps/control-plane-api/src/index.ts CreateServerOptions add optional transactionStore?: TransactionReadStore; resolve it like resolvePolicyStore (in-memory for local/test/development, require injection otherwise), and register transactionRoutesPlugin in createServer(). In apps/control-plane-api/src/main.ts construct createPostgresTransactionStore(database) from DATABASE_URL and inject it via serverOptions alongside the existing policyStore. Keep the existing GET /control/v1/merchants placeholder working (do not break it).

BACKEND unit tests: add apps/control-plane-api/src/transaction-routes.test.ts mirroring policy-routes.test.ts (jose RS256 token minting against local JWKS, in-memory store seeded with fixtures). Cover: unauthenticated => 401; list returns seeded transactions for the owning merchant; list for a DIFFERENT merchant scope => 403 (cross-merchant list blocked); getTransaction for owned id returns it; getTransaction for another merchant's id => 403 or 404 (tenant isolation); unknown id => 404; limit/offset respected; amount is in MAJOR units; currentState/transitions derived correctly for a draft-only vs fully-settled step sequence. Also add a focused unit test for deriveTransactionState/buildTransitions covering initiated/authorized/captured/settled/failed and that .claim rows are excluded.

BACKEND integration test (creds/DB-gated, MUST run not skip): add apps/control-plane-api/src/transaction-projection.integration.test.ts (or place in packages/data if pg wiring is cleaner there). Gate on DATABASE_URL like apps/worker/src/concurrency.integration.test.ts (const gated = databaseUrl ? describe : describe.skip). In beforeAll/the test: using PostgresDatabase(databaseUrl), INSERT its OWN uniquely-keyed rows into runtime.workflow_intents (scope_kind='merchant', scope_id=<TEST_MERCHANT_A>, a unique transaction_id, valid command_digest matching the sha256:<64hex> CHECK if that table has such a constraint -- verify constraints first), runtime.lifecycle_steps (idempotency_key=transaction_id, steps completed), and runtime.spend_ledger (reference=transaction_id, amount_minor, currency INR). Then call the Postgres store directly (createPostgresTransactionStore) AND/OR drive the route via server.inject with a minted token to assert: (a) the projected Transaction reflects the seeded real rows (amount in MAJOR units, currentState derived, transitions present); (b) a second merchant (TEST_MERCHANT_B) cannot see merchant A's transaction via list or by id (tenant isolation). In afterAll, DELETE exactly the rows this test inserted (by the unique transaction_id / reference). NEVER drop/truncate/migrate. Confirm via test output that the suite RAN (not skipped) when DATABASE_URL is exported.

FRONT-END wiring: edit apps/merchant-console/src/app/transactions/page.tsx. DELETE the DEMO_TRANSACTIONS array entirely. Keep the columns definitions and getStatusVariant. Make the page fetch real data: derive merchantId the same way other authed pages do (inspect apps/merchant-console/src/lib/identity.ts and auth.ts and at least one already-wired page to copy the exact pattern), call const { data, loading, error, refetch } = useApi(client => client.listTransactions(merchantId), [merchantId]) from ../../hooks/use-api.js. Render: loading => Skeleton (e.g. a few SkeletonText/Skeleton rows); error => <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={refetch} />; empty (data && data.length===0) => <EmptyState icon={<Receipt/>} title="No transactions yet" description=... />; otherwise <DataTable columns={columns} data={data as ...} emptyMessage=... />. Preserve the existing PageWrapper + heading. Keep the file a client component.
VERIFY end-to-end: run pnpm build, pnpm test (full), pnpm depcruise, and the integration test WITH DATABASE_URL exported; confirm no leftover test rows remain (re-run the count script).
acceptance_criteria: New endpoints exist: GET /control/v1/merchants/:merchantId/transactions and GET /control/v1/transactions/:transactionId, registered in createServer(), returning bodies that satisfy the existing api-client (array of Transaction for list; single Transaction for get)

The read-model projection maps workflow_intents+lifecycle_steps+spend_ledger to the front-end Transaction shape with amount in MAJOR units, and buyerRef/method gaps documented (not fabricated) in findings
Tenant isolation enforced: a merchant scope cannot list or getById another merchant's transaction (covered by unit tests returning 403/404)

apps/merchant-console/src/app/transactions/page.tsx no longer contains DEMO_TRANSACTIONS and fetches via useApi(client.listTransactions), with loading/empty/error states rendered via @counter/ui components
pnpm build passes; pnpm test passes with the new unit tests added (total > baseline); pnpm depcruise clean

The integration test RUNS (not skipped) with DATABASE_URL exported, proves a seeded real transaction projects correctly AND that cross-merchant reads are blocked, and cleans up its own rows (post-run runtime.* counts return to pre-test values)

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd ~/counterX && pnpm test
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd ~/counterX && pnpm depcruise

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd ~/counterX && DATABASE_URL="$(grep '^DATABASE_URL=' .env | cut -d= -f2-)" pnpm --filter @counter/control-plane-api test 2>&1 | grep -iE 'projection|integration|pass|skip'
findings:
IMPLEMENTED end-to-end and verified against LIVE Supabase.

Backend: new apps/control-plane-api/src/transaction-routes.ts (API types matching apps/merchant-console/src/lib/types.ts exactly; TransactionReadStore port; createInMemoryTransactionStore; pure documented deriveTransactionState + buildTransitions grounded in real-lifecycle.ts steps shopify.draft/finalize/markPaid -> authorized/captured/settled, declined step or intent.status='failed' => failed, .claim rows excluded; verifyTenantAccess identical to policy-routes.ts; two GET routes returning raw array / single object bodies as the api-client expects). Postgres adapter apps/control-plane-api/src/transaction-store-postgres.ts assembles from runtime.workflow_intents (spine, scope_kind='merchant'+scope_id) + runtime.lifecycle_steps (idempotency_key=transaction_id, ordered) + runtime.spend_ledger (reference=transaction_id, amount_minor/100 => MAJOR). Store is environment-parameterized (createPostgresTransactionStore(database, environment)); getTransaction resolves the intent, returns its scope_id as owning merchantId, and the route 404s (no disclosure) on tenant mismatch and on unknown id. Wired via CreateServerOptions.transactionStore in index.ts (resolveTransactionStore: in-memory for local/test/development, require injection otherwise) and main.ts (createPostgresTransactionStore(database, environment) alongside the policy store).

KNOWN GAPS (documented, NOT fabricated): buyerRef and method have no dedicated persisted column today (lifecycle_steps.snapshot is always null). The projection reads workflow_intents.authority_context->>'buyerRef' and ->>'method' when present, otherwise emits explicit placeholders BUYER_REF_UNAVAILABLE='(unavailable)' and METHOD_UNKNOWN='unknown'. currency is pinned to 'INR' per the front-end literal type.

Front-end: apps/merchant-console/src/app/transactions/page.tsx now has NO DEMO_TRANSACTIONS; it fetches via useApi(client => client.listTransactions(MERCHANT_ID), [MERCHANT_ID]) and renders Skeleton (loading), ErrorState({message,onRetry:refetch}) (error), EmptyState({icon:<Receipt/>,...}) (empty), else DataTable. merchantId is sourced from NEXT_PUBLIC_MERCHANT_ID with the pilot fallback ('merchant-pilot-001'); server-side scope enforcement is the real tenant guard.

DEVIATIONS (minimal, necessary):
1) The import path for the hook was changed from the planned '../../hooks/use-api.js' to the '@/hooks/use-api' alias (matching the file's existing @/components and @/lib imports) because Next/Turbopack could not resolve the '.js' extension on a relative TS import; the build failed otherwise.
2) apps/merchant-console/src/hooks/use-api.ts relative imports of '../lib/api-client.js' were switched to the '@/lib/api-client' alias for the same Turbopack resolution reason. This hook was previously never in any built page's graph, so the latent '.js' resolution issue only surfaced once the Transactions page imported it. No behavior/contract change.
3) apps/control-plane-api/src/index.test.ts: the existing 'production requires a durable store' tests were updated to also require/inject a transactionStore, because production-like environments now correctly refuse to start without one (mirrors the pre-existing policyStore invariant).
4) transaction-store-postgres.ts declares a local SqlRow=Record<string,unknown> instead of importing pg's QueryResultRow, because 'pg' types are not resolvable directly from the app package (pg is only a transitive runtime dep via @counter/data); adding a direct pg dependency edge would risk depcruise. Runtime works because PostgresDatabase from @counter/data owns pg.

INTEGRATION TEST OUTCOME: apps/control-plane-api/src/transaction-projection.integration.test.ts is DATABASE_URL-gated (describe.skip when absent). With DATABASE_URL exported it RAN (NOT skipped) and PASSED (2 tests): it inspected the live CHECK constraints first (workflow_intents needs only non-empty command_digest/command_type/transaction_id and scope_kind/status enums; lifecycle_steps status IN completed/declined; spend_ledger amount_minor>0, currency len=3), seeded uniquely-keyed rows under a dedicated 'sandbox' environment (workflow_intents + 4 lifecycle_steps incl a .claim guard + spend_ledger 150000 minor), asserted the projected Transaction reflects them (amount=1500 MAJOR, currentState='settled', transitions initiated->authorized->captured->settled with evidenceRef, buyerRef/method from authority_context) via BOTH the Postgres store and the HTTP route, and asserted TEST_MERCHANT_B cannot see them (empty list for B, 403 on cross-merchant list, 404 on getById). afterAll DELETEd exactly the seeded rows by (environment, transaction_id/reference); NEVER dropped/truncated/migrated. Post-run runtime.* counts re-verified back to 0 (workflow_intents=0, lifecycle_steps=0, spend_ledger=0).

VERIFICATION: pnpm build clean (all packages incl 4 Next apps); pnpm test = 2811 passed / 25 skipped (0 failed; baseline was 2791 passed / 23 skipped, +20 new unit tests); pnpm depcruise clean (2140 modules, no violations); integration test proven against live infra as above.
